ParameterSeparator.Text: The device is KNX Data Secure-capable. KNX Data Secure offers protection against manipulation in building automation and can be configured in the ETS project. Detailed specialist knowledge is required.
A device certificate, which is attached to the side of the device, is required for Data Secure commissioning. During mounting, the certificate must be removed from the device and stored securely.

The enclosed Secure Card contains all important device data, including the device certificate for Data Secure commissioning, and is thus used for commissioning and for simple and secure storage of the device data.
The secure card and the device certificate label must be kept in a safe place. A recovery of the device data incl. the device certificate is not possible, not even by the manufacturer.
